mic_rtsim.talk.any.fluff.1: Fine day for it, whatever it is.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.fluff.3: You look like you've walked a long way.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.state.busy.1: One customer at a time, friend.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.state.busy.2: Can't you see I'm with someone?
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.0: Morning, or whatever it is. I lose track.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.1: If you're selling, I'm not buying. If you're buying, come closer.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.2: My cousin swears the bell rings by itself at night. My cousin swears a lot of things.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.3: Hrm. You're not from around here.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.4: Mind the chickens. They mind nobody.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.5: We had a wandering trader last month. Sold me a fish with a hat on. I still don't know why.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.6: I keep meaning to fix that fence. I keep meaning a lot of things.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.7: You've got the look of someone who opens chests that aren't theirs.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.8: Nothing ever happens here. I like it that way.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.9: Have you eaten? You look thin. Everyone looks thin to me.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.home.0: Welcome to %1$s. Mind the well, it's deeper than it looks.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.home.1: Born in %1$s, I'll die in %1$s. Not soon, I hope.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.home.3: Folk in %1$s keep their doors shut at night. You'd do well to learn why.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.home.4: If anyone asks, %1$s has the best bread in the valley. Nobody asks.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.dawn.0: Up with the sun, are you? Good habit.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.dawn.1: The rooster beat me again. One day, rooster.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.dawn.2: Early, isn't it? The dew's still on everything.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.day.0: Busy day. They're all busy days.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.day.2: Bright out. Mind you don't burn.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.dusk.0: Getting dark. You'll want to be indoors soon.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.dusk.1: Bell's about to ring for supper.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.dusk.2: Sky's going orange. Means the zombies are getting up.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.night.0: You shouldn't be out. Nobody should be out.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.night.1: Shh. Do you hear groaning? I hear groaning.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.night.2: Why are you knocking about at this hour? Get inside.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.rain.0: Rain again. The crops like it. My roof doesn't.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.rain.1: You're soaked through. There's a dry bench under the bell, if you want it.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.rain.2: Smells like wet hay and worms. Lovely.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.thunder.0: Stay away from the tall trees. Lightning loves the tall trees.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.thunder.1: Thunder like that wakes the dead. Literally, round here.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.thunder.2: Lightning hit the church once. Turned the pig outside into something nasty.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.snow.0: Cold enough to freeze the well. It did last year.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.snow.1: Snow on the roofs. Pretty, until you have to shovel it.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.snow.2: My fingers have stopped talking to me.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.clear.0: Not a cloud. Good day for drying wool.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.clear.1: Clear sky. You can see the next ridge from the tower.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.clear.2: Fine weather. Something's bound to go wrong.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.hot.0: Hot enough to cook an egg on the path. Don't, though.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.hot.1: The well's running low in this heat.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.cold.0: Wrap up. The cold here bites.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.wet.0: Everything's damp. The bread's damp. I'm damp.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.wet.1: The mud here could swallow a cart.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.dry.1: Not a drop of rain in weeks. The crops are begging.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.ocean.0: Salt in the air, salt in the bread.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.ocean.1: Watch the tide. It takes careless folk.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.mountain.0: Air's thin up here. You get used to it. Mostly.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.mountain.1: Goats on the ridge again. Noisy brutes.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.forest.0: The woods go on forever. I never go past the third oak.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.forest.1: Strange things in the trees after dark.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.plains.0: Flat as a table out here. You see trouble coming a mile off.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.swamp.0: Mind the witch's hut. We don't talk about the witch.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.swamp.1: The frogs never stop. Day and night, croaking.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.snowy.0: Snow's been here since my grandmother's day.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.snowy.1: Keep moving or you'll freeze in place.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.jungle.0: Vines grow back faster than we cut them.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.jungle.1: Parrots stole my hat. I want it back.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.savanna.0: Hot wind, dry grass. Keep fire well away.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.savanna.1: The horses out here run wild. Good luck catching one.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.taiga.0: Pine needles in my boots again.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.taiga.1: Wolves in the spruce. Keep your sheep close.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.badlands.0: Red rock everywhere. Even the dust is red.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fluff.badlands.1: Old mines out there. Don't go in them.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.state.asleep.1: Mmph. Go away. It's sleeping time.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.state.busy.0: One at a time. I've only got the one pair of hands.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.state.busy.1: Can't you see I'm trading? Wait your turn.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.state.busy.2: Busy. Come back in a moment.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.state.hurt.0: Ow. Something bit me. Something big.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.state.hurt.1: I'm hurt. Get the cleric, would you?
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.raid.1: Ring the bell! Why is nobody ringing the bell?
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.raid.2: They're burning the fields. Help us or hide!
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.raid.3: Pillagers at the gate. Don't just stand there!
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.afraid.0: After what happened, I barely sleep.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.afraid.1: They came two nights ago. They'll come again.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.afraid.2: Lock your door tonight. We all are.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.afraid.3: Every noise in the dark, I think it's them again.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.uneasy.1: We had trouble not long ago. Folk are jumpy.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.uneasy.2: Keep your eyes open. We've been keeping ours open.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.uneasy.3: It's been quiet since. Too quiet, my mother would say.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.monsters.0: Can you hear them? Out past the fence.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.monsters.1: Something's moving out there. Something dead.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.monsters.2: Zombies at the edge of the lamplight. Don't go out.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.liked.0: Oh, it's you! Good to see a friendly face.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.liked.1: You've done right by us. Folk remember that.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.liked.2: Back again? Come in, come in.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.liked.3: If you need anything, you only have to ask.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.disliked.1: I'd rather not talk to you, if it's all the same.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.disliked.2: Folk talk about you, you know. Not kindly.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.disliked.3: Keep your hands where I can see them.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.hated.1: The golems know your face. So do we.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.hated.2: You've done enough harm here. Leave.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.dear.0: %1$s costs what gold did last spring.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.dear.1: Can't get %1$s for love or money. Mostly money.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.dear.2: If you've %1$s to spare, the market's crying for it.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.cheap.0: We're drowning in %1$s. Take some, please.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.cheap.2: %1$s is going for next to nothing. Bad for us, good for you.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.hungry.1: The stores are low. Very low.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.hungry.2: My children asked for supper. I gave them a story instead.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.feud.0: %1$s have it in for us. Don't ask me why.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.feud.1: %1$s want our blood. We'd like to keep it.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.feud.2: If you're friends with %1$s, you're no friend of ours.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.dragon.0: The dragon was here. You can still smell the smoke.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.dragon.1: %1$s came over the hills. We lost the barn.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.dragon.2: Watch the sky. %1$s hunts these parts.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.port_closed: The port's closed. Not a ship in or out.
The ships just sit at the dock. Empty holds, idle crews.
Nothing comes by sea anymore. The market's half empty.
Pirates hold the lanes. The port might as well not be here.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.blockade.0: Pirates are hunting every ship that leaves. The captains won't sail.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.blockade.1: They say the pirates are choking the port.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mood.blockade.2: Every sail on the horizon is a pirate these days.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.armorer.fluff.0: Iron's iron. It's how you hammer it that counts.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.armorer.fluff.1: Come back when you've got a dent worth fixing.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.armorer.fluff.2: A good helmet's saved more heads than any cleric.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.armorer.fluff.3: Chainmail itches. Everyone complains. Everyone wears it.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.armorer.fluff.4: My forge never goes out. Neither do I, apparently.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.butcher.fluff.0: Fresh pork today. Fresher than yesterday's, anyway.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.butcher.fluff.1: Mind the cleaver. It's not for show.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.butcher.fluff.2: Coal for the smoker, coal for the smoker. Always coal.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.butcher.fluff.3: A good stew needs a good rabbit. A good rabbit needs catching.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.butcher.fluff.4: You look like you could do with a chop.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.cartographer.flu: Every road goes somewhere. Most go somewhere dull.
I've mapped every hill for a day's ride. Then the hills moved. Don't ask.
If you find a new place, tell me. I'll draw it badly but proudly.
Ships, ports, caravans: I hear where everyone's going. It's my job.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.cleric.fluff.0: The stars were wrong last night. I'm sure of it.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.cleric.fluff.1: Bring me a rotten thing and I'll make it useful.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.cleric.fluff.2: The bones speak, if you know how to listen. Mostly they say 'ow'.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.cleric.fluff.3: Bless you. That'll be an emerald.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.cleric.fluff.4: Strange things walk the dark. Pray they don't find you.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.farmer.fluff.0: Rain on the barley, sun on the wheat. That's the hope.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.farmer.fluff.1: Crows got the seed again. I'll get the crows.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.farmer.fluff.2: Carrots don't grow themselves. More's the pity.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.farmer.fluff.3: Bone meal. If you've any, I'm your friend.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.farmer.fluff.4: Good soil this year. Don't jinx it.
The fish were biting at dawn. Then they weren't.
The river remembers everyone who fell in.
I caught a boot once. Two, actually. Matching.
Salt in my beard, scales on my hands. Happy man.
If the boats come in full, we eat well. If not, we eat fish anyway.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fletcher.fluff.0: Feathers, flint and a straight stick. That's all an arrow is.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fletcher.fluff.1: A crooked arrow's worse than no arrow.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fletcher.fluff.2: Skeletons shoot better than most hunters. Don't tell the hunters.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.fletcher.fluff.3: I'll trade sticks for anything. I like sticks.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.leatherworker.fl: Good hide's hard to come by. Cows are getting clever.
Tanning stinks. You get used to it. Nobody else does.
A good saddle lasts a lifetime. A bad one, an afternoon.
Rabbit hide makes a fine cap. A small one.
Words, words. Everyone wants enchantments, nobody wants a good book.
Quiet, please. The pages are sleeping.
I've read everything in this village. Twice. Thrice, the cookbook.
Paper doesn't grow on trees. Well. It does, technically.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mason.fluff.0: Stone lasts. Folk don't. That's why I work stone.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mason.fluff.1: Every wall I build outlives me. Comforting, that.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mason.fluff.3: A good arch holds itself up. I envy it.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.mason.fluff.4: Mind the mortar, it's still wet.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.nitwit.fluff.0: Did you know clouds are just sky sheep? I'm almost sure.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.nitwit.fluff.1: I've been standing here all day. It's going very well.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.nitwit.fluff.2: If you stare at the sun it gets bigger. Wait, smaller. Ow.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.nitwit.fluff.3: I had a job once. I think. It was a long time ago, this morning.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.nitwit.fluff.4: Hello! Hello again! Was that too many hellos?
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.shepherd.fluff.0: Count them with me. One, two... where's the third?
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.shepherd.fluff.1: Wolves on the hill again. The dogs are nervous.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.shepherd.fluff.2: White wool sells. Pink wool sells better, for some reason.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.shepherd.fluff.3: Shearing season's the best season. The sheep disagree.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.shepherd.fluff.4: A sheep knows the weather before the farmer does.
A tool's only as good as the hand that holds it. And the iron.
Blunt pickaxe? Bring it here, before you hurt yourself.
I've made a thousand shovels. Every one dug a hole somewhere.
Iron, coal, sweat. The rest is talk.
Don't use my hoe as a weapon. People do. It's sad.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.weaponsmith.fluf: A sword's a promise. Make sure you can keep it.
Every blade I sell, I hope never comes back bloody. They all do.
Axe or sword? Axe. Always axe.
The forge is hot and so's my temper. Buying or not?
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.none.fluff.0: I'm looking for work. Know anyone who needs a pair of hands?
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.none.fluff.2: Is there a lectern going spare? A barrel? Anything?
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.none.fluff.3: I'd be a farmer, if someone built me a composter.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.none.fluff.4: Every workstation's taken. Story of my life.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.cartographer.flu: %1$s is on every map I've drawn. Not that many people buy them.
Roads out of %1$s go every which way. Most of them to mud.
mic_rtsim.talk.child.fluff.1: Mum says not to talk to strangers. You're a stranger.
mic_rtsim.talk.child.fluff.2: I found a beetle! You can't have it.
mic_rtsim.talk.child.fluff.3: When I grow up I'm going to be a dragon.
mic_rtsim.talk.child.fluff.4: Are you an adventurer? Have you killed a zombie? Have you killed two?
mic_rtsim.talk.child.fluff.5: My brother says iron golems eat naughty children. Is that true?
mic_rtsim.talk.child.fluff.night.0: I'm not scared of the dark. I'm not!
mic_rtsim.talk.child.fluff.night.1: Mum says the zombies can't get in. Can they?
mic_rtsim.talk.child.mood.raid.1: They're scary! Make them go away!
mic_rtsim.talk.child.mood.afraid.0: Will the bad men come back?
mic_rtsim.talk.child.mood.afraid.1: I don't like it when it's quiet now.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.fluff.0: Roads are roads. This one has fewer bandits than the last.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.fluff.1: Buy now. I'm gone by morning.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.fluff.2: Everyone wants copper. I want a dry bed.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.fluff.3: The llamas know the way better than I do. Don't tell them.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.fluff.4: I've sold to kings and beggars. The beggars haggle less.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.fluff.5: Seen one village, seen them all. Except this one. This one's special. Buy something.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.fluff.6: Prices are what they are. Blame the road.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.fluff.7: I hear things on the road. Things cost extra.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.fluff.rain.0: Rain on the road means mud on the wheels.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.fluff.rain.1: The llamas hate the rain. They spit more.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.fluff.thunder.0: Lightning spooks the llamas. Spooked llamas run.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.fluff.thunder.1: I'm not moving till this passes.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.fluff.snow.0: Snow in the passes. The long way round, then.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.fluff.night.0: I don't travel at night. Neither should you.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.fluff.night.1: Even the llamas won't walk in this dark.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.mood.liked.0: You again! My favourite customer. Don't tell the others.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.mood.liked.1: For you, a fair price. Almost.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.mood.disliked.0: I know your face. Robbed one of ours, didn't you?
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.mood.disliked.1: Hands off the llamas. I'm watching.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.state.busy.0: One at a time, one at a time.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.state.busy.1: Wait your turn. The goods aren't going anywhere. Well, I am.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.mood.port_closed.0: Nothing moves by sea there now. Good for me, bad for them.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.mood.port_closed.1: Ports closed, roads busy. I'm not complaining.
mic_rtsim.talk.ref.camp: a camp out in the wilds
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.assault.other.1: They say %1$s went for %2$s %4$s. That was %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.assault.other.se: Saw it with my own eyes: %1$s laid into %2$s %4$s, %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.assault.you.0: You hurt %2$s %3$s. Folk talk, you know.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.assault.you.1: I heard what you did to %2$s %3$s. Not your finest hour.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.assault.to_you.0: I heard %1$s went for you %3$s. Glad you're standing.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.assault.to_you.1: Word is %1$s attacked you %3$s. Watch your back.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.assault.us.2: We're still sore about %3$s. %1$s attacked us.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.killing.other.1: They say %2$s is dead. %1$s did it, %4$s, %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.killing.other.se: I saw %1$s kill %2$s %4$s, %3$s. I still see it when I close my eyes.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.killing.you.0: They say you killed %2$s %3$s. Is it true?
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.killing.you.1: Everyone knows you did for %2$s %3$s. Everyone.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.killing.to_you.1: Word is %1$s tried to kill you %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.killing.us.0: One of ours was killed %3$s. %1$s did it.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.robbery.other.se: I saw %1$s rob %2$s %4$s, %3$s. Took the lot.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.robbery.you.0: You robbed %2$s %3$s. Word travels faster than carts.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.robbery.you.1: Folk say you helped yourself to the goods of %2$s %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.robbery.us.0: We were robbed blind %3$s. It was %1$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.robbery.us.2: Since %1$s robbed us %3$s, we've been counting every crust.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.theft.other.0: Heard %1$s made off with a llama from %2$s %4$s, %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.theft.other.1: They say %1$s stole from %2$s %4$s, %3$s. A llama, of all things.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.theft.you.0: Folk say you took a caravan's llama %3$s. They want it back.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.theft.you.1: A llama went missing %3$s. People are looking at you.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.theft.to_you.0: Heard someone made off with your beast %3$s. %1$s, they say.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.theft.us.0: Somebody pinched our animals %3$s. %1$s, I'd bet.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.trade.other.1: They say %1$s trades fair with %2$s. Rare these days.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.trade.you.0: You traded fair with %2$s %3$s. That gets around.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.trade.you.1: Folk say you deal honest. That's worth something here.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.trade.to_you.0: Heard %1$s gave you a fair deal %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.trade.us.0: Good folk, %1$s. Traded fair with us %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.trade.us.1: Good trading with %1$s %3$s. Come again, I say.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.rescue.other.1: They say %1$s drove off whatever was after %2$s %4$s, %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.rescue.other.see: I saw %1$s save %2$s %4$s, %3$s. Brave, or daft.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.rescue.you.0: You saved %2$s %3$s! Folk are still talking about it.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.rescue.you.1: They say you came to the rescue of %2$s %3$s. Good on you.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.rescue.to_you.0: Heard %1$s pulled you out of trouble %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.rescue.us.1: If not for %1$s %3$s, we'd be done for.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.resident_assault: Heard %1$s hurt one of the folk of %2$s %3$s.
They say %1$s attacked a villager at %2$s %3$s.
I saw %1$s strike one of the people of %2$s %3$s.
You struck one of the folk of %2$s %3$s. They won't forget.
Word is you hurt someone in %2$s %3$s. Shameful.
One of ours was hurt %3$s. %1$s did it.
One of us is still limping since %3$s. %1$s did that.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.resident_killing: Heard %1$s killed one of the folk of %2$s %3$s.
They say someone in %2$s was murdered %3$s. They blame %1$s.
I saw %1$s kill one of the people of %2$s %3$s.
You killed one of the folk of %2$s %3$s. Murderer.
They say you've blood on your hands from %2$s, %3$s.
We lost one of ours to %1$s %3$s. Murdered.
We lost a neighbour %3$s. %1$s did it.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.encroachment.oth: Folk say a dragon's taken an interest in the works %4$s.
Heard the smoke from the works %4$s has drawn something big.
The works have drawn a dragon's eye. I don't like it.
Something in the sky watches our chimneys. Ever since %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.feud.other.1: They say %1$s want blood from %2$s. Since %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.feud.other.2: Heard %1$s and %2$s are at each other's throats.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.feud.to_you.0: Word is %1$s want your head. I'd keep off the roads.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.feud.to_you.1: They say %1$s have sworn against you. Be careful.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.feud.to_you.2: Heard %1$s are looking for you. Not to share a pie.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.feud.us.0: Watch out for %1$s. They've had it in for us since %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.feud.us.1: Word is %1$s mean to come for us.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.feud.us.2: They say %1$s hate us. I don't even know what we did.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.feud.by_us.0: We've sworn against %2$s. There's no going back.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.pact_sworn.other: Word is %1$s and %2$s have sworn a pact.
They say %1$s stand with %2$s now. Trouble for someone.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.pact_sworn.us.0: Heard %1$s have made friends with %2$s. Friends of our enemies are no friends of ours.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.pact_broken.othe: Word is %1$s turned on %2$s. So much for oaths.
They say the pact between %1$s and %2$s is broken.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.pact_broken.us.0: So %1$s broke faith with %2$s. Serves them right.
I saw %1$s raid %2$s %4$s, %3$s. Smoke for a day.
We watched the smoke over %2$s %3$s. %1$s did that.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.raid.to_you.1: Heard %1$s went after you %3$s. Did you hold?
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.raid.us.0: We were raided %3$s, by %1$s. Nobody's slept right since.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.raid.us.1: When %1$s came %3$s, we lost half the barn.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.raid.by_us.0: We hit %2$s %3$s. They had it coming.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.fell.other.0: Word is %2$s is dead. %1$s will have a new chief.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.fell.other.1: They say %2$s fell %3$s. Things will change out there.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.fell.you.0: They say you killed %2$s %3$s. %1$s won't forget that.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.fell.you.1: Word is you did for %2$s. %1$s will be wanting a word.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.fell.us.0: So %2$s is dead. We'll see what %1$s does now.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.fell.by_us.0: We lost %2$s %3$s. We mourn, then we choose.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.port_raided.othe: Word is %1$s raided the docks at %2$s %3$s.
I saw the pirates hit %2$s %3$s. Burning sails, the lot.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.port_raided.us.0: Pirates raided our docks %3$s. %1$s, bold as you like.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.port_raided.us.1: Pirates came off the water %3$s. %1$s, they call themselves.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.blockade.other.0: Word is %1$s are hunting ships off %2$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.blockade.other.1: They say no captain sails from %2$s these days, not past %1$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.blockade.us.0: The harbour's choked. %1$s, out past the point. Ships won't leave.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.blockade.us.1: Every sail on the horizon is %1$s these days.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.port_closed.othe: Heard the port at %2$s is shut. %1$s saw to that.
They say nothing moves in or out of %2$s. Pirates.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.port_closed.us.0: Our port's closed. %1$s hold the lanes.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.port_closed.us.1: The port's been shut since %3$s. Blame %1$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.port_reopened.ot: Heard ships are moving at %2$s again.
They say the port at %2$s is open again.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.port_reopened.us: The port's open again. About time.
Ships in the harbour again since %3$s. Feels like spring.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.haven_fell.other: They say the pirate nest at %2$s is gone. %1$s did it, %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.news.haven_fell.by_us: Our ships burned out %2$s %3$s. Good riddance.
Robbed blind, we were, %3$s, by %1$s. The market's still bare.
Since %3$s, when %1$s came, we lock the granary.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.news.raid.us.0: The bell rang and rang %3$s. %1$s raided us.
mic_rtsim.talk.villager.news.raid.us.1: When %1$s came %3$s, I hid in the well. Don't laugh.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.news.robbery.other: I go the long way now. %1$s took a whole train %4$s, %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.news.theft.other.0: Nobody's safe. %2$s lost a llama to %1$s %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.trader.news.port_closed.o: The port at %2$s is shut. Good for the roads, bad for them.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.mood.afraid.0: After what happened, I'm jumping at shadows.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.mood.afraid.1: Not now. Not after the trouble we've had.
mic_rtsim.talk.any.mood.uneasy.0: It's been an uneasy few days.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.fluff.0: Hehe. You smell like soap. Disgusting.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.fluff.1: Boss says no biting visitors. Boss says a lot of things.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.fluff.2: Got a shiny? No? Then what good are you?
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.fluff.3: I found a spoon today. Best day of my life.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.fluff.4: Mud's warm, grub's fat, boss is asleep. Good day.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.fluff.5: Don't look at my pile. It's not a pile. It's nothing. Go away.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.fluff.night.0: Dark is good. Dark is when the shinies come out of their houses. Hehe.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.fluff.rain.0: Rain makes the tunnels drippy. I like drippy.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.fluff.day.0: Sun's too bright. Hurts the eyes. Hurts the everything.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.state.hurt.0: Ow! Ow ow. Who did this? Was it you?
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.state.hurt.1: Bleeding a bit. Only a bit. Don't get ideas.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.mood.cowed.0: Boss is dead. Nobody's laughing. Not even me.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.mood.cowed.1: We keep our heads down now. Down and quiet. For a bit.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.mood.new_chief.0: New boss. Shouts more than the old one. Bites harder too.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.mood.new_chief.1: We got a new boss. Still learning which way he hits.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.mood.chief_out.0: Boss is out with the lads. Back with shinies, maybe. Or not back.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.mood.chief_out.1: Boss took the big ones out raiding. Left me to guard the mud.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.mood.lean.0: Not many of us left. Don't count us. I said don't count!
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.mood.lean.1: Half the bunks are empty. More grub for me, hehe. Less of everything else.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.mood.strong.0: Look at us! So many! Too many to count, and I can't count!
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.mood.strong.1: Camp's full to bursting. Boss is getting ideas.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.mood.grudge.0: Boss knows your face. Boss doesn't like your face.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.mood.grudge.1: You've been naughty, squishy thing. Boss is keeping score.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.raid.by_us.0: We hit %2$s %3$s! So many shinies! Well, some.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.raid.by_us.1: Went to %2$s %3$s. Came back heavier. Hehe.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.robbery.by_us: Took a cart off %2$s %3$s. Finders keepers.
Too much stuff at %2$s. We fixed that, %3$s.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.feud.by_us.0: Boss swore on his best spoon against %2$s. He never swears on the spoon.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.feud.by_us.1: We're coming for %2$s. Maybe not today. Soon.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.fell.by_us.0: So %2$s is gone, %3$s. We ate quietly that night. Mostly.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.fell.by_us.1: We lost %2$s %3$s. Somebody's got to be boss now.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.killing.you.0: You killed %2$s %3$s! The whole camp knows. The whole camp!
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.killing.you.1: We know it was you. %2$s, %3$s. We remember.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.killing.us.0: Someone did for one of ours %3$s. %1$s, they say. We're sharpening things.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.killing.us.1: One of ours didn't come home %3$s. %1$s did that.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.assault.you.0: You hit one of ours %3$s. He's still crying about it.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.assault.you.1: Heard you thumped one of the lads %3$s. Not nice. Funny, but not nice.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.rescue.you.0: You took back what we took from %2$s, %3$s. Not fair. Not fair!
Since %3$s, %1$s has been stomping round our hills. Boss noticed.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.pact_sworn.by: Boss shook hands with %2$s %3$s. Then he counted his fingers.
mic_rtsim.talk.goblin.news.pact_broken.b: We were friends with %2$s. Then we weren't. Hehe.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.fluff.0: Keep your hands where I can see them. This is a courtesy.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.fluff.1: The captain keeps a list. Pray you are not on it.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.fluff.2: We train at dawn and burn at dusk. The rest is waiting.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.fluff.3: Villagers trade. We take. It saves a great deal of talking.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.fluff.4: My axe was my father's. It has seen more doors than I have.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.fluff.5: You are either brave or lost. Neither lasts long out here.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.fluff.night.0: Night is for watching. You are being watched now.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.fluff.dusk.0: Dusk. The best light for a fire.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.state.hurt.0: A scratch. Ask the one who gave it how he is doing.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.state.hurt.1: I have been cut. It changes nothing.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.mood.cowed.0: The captain is dead. Until another rises, we wait.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.mood.cowed.1: We lost a fight. We do not speak of it, and neither will you.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.mood.new_chief.0: We serve a new captain. Harder than the last, they say. Good.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.mood.new_chief.1: A new banner hangs in the hall. The old one burned with its captain.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.mood.chief_out.0: The captain rides with the band. The hall is quiet without him.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.mood.chief_out.1: The captain is away. That does not make you safe.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.mood.lean.0: Our ranks are thin. Do not mistake that for weak.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.mood.lean.1: Too many empty bunks. Recruits will come. They always do.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.mood.strong.0: The hall is full. The captain will want a reason to empty it.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.mood.strong.1: Every bed taken, every blade sharp. Something is coming.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.mood.grudge.0: Your name has been said in the hall. Not kindly.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.mood.grudge.1: The captain has noticed you. Few survive that twice.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.news.raid.by_us.0: We burned %2$s %3$s. They will rebuild. We will return.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.news.raid.by_us.1: We collected what %2$s owed %3$s. In smoke.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.news.robbery.by_us: We relieved %2$s of its goods %3$s. Efficiently.
A tax was collected from %2$s %3$s. They did not agree to it.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.news.feud.by_us.0: The captain has marked %2$s. It is only a matter of time.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.news.feud.by_us.1: We are sworn against %2$s. Oaths are kept here.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.news.fell.by_us.0: We buried %2$s %3$s, and raised another captain.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.news.fell.by_us.1: We lost %2$s %3$s. The hall still smells of the pyre.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.news.killing.you.0: You killed %2$s %3$s. That is a debt, and we collect debts.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.news.killing.you.1: We know what you did to %2$s. %3$s. Every one of us knows.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.news.killing.us.0: One of ours was cut down %3$s. %1$s. The name is written.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.news.killing.us.1: We lost a man %3$s. %1$s will answer for it.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.news.assault.you.0: You struck one of ours %3$s. Bold. Foolish, but bold.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.news.rescue.you.0: You took %2$s back from us %3$s. The captain remembers who interferes.
Since %3$s, %1$s has walked our ground. We have counted every step.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.news.pact_sworn.by: We swore with %2$s %3$s. Allies are useful, for a while.
mic_rtsim.talk.raider.news.pact_broken.b: Our pact with %2$s is ash. They knew it would come to this.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.fluff.0: Nice boots. Shame if they walked off without you.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.fluff.1: Road's quiet today. Quiet roads are bad for business.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.fluff.2: I was a farmer once. Then I met a tax man. Now I'm the tax man.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.fluff.3: We don't rob the poor. They haven't got anything.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.fluff.4: Every coin you carry is a coin you could lose. Just saying.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.fluff.5: Fire's warm, stew's thin, and nobody's hanging us today. Can't complain.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.fluff.night.0: Night's when honest folk stay home. So who's that make you?
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.fluff.rain.0: Rain keeps the merchants off the road. Bad weather for us.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.state.hurt.0: Took a knock. Don't get clever.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.state.hurt.1: Bit of blood. Seen worse. Done worse.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.mood.cowed.0: The boss is dead. Half the lads are talking about going straight.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.mood.cowed.1: We lost the boss. Nobody's in a hurry to go out on the road.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.mood.new_chief.0: New boss. Keeps a tighter purse than the last. Tighter rope too.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.mood.new_chief.1: Got a new boss. Still working out what he likes, and who.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.mood.chief_out.0: Boss is out on the road with the lads. Pray he's not on yours.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.mood.chief_out.1: Boss went out with the crew. Left me minding the loot. Don't touch.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.mood.lean.0: Not many of us left. The rope's been busy.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.mood.lean.1: Thin times. Half the camp ran or hanged.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.mood.strong.0: Every bedroll taken. Boss is talking about a big score.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.mood.strong.1: Lot of new faces round the fire. Lot of hungry faces.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.mood.grudge.0: Boss has heard your name. That's never good.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.mood.grudge.1: You've got a price on you, friend. Not a big one. Yet.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.news.raid.by_us.0: We hit %2$s %3$s. Good haul. Don't ask what.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.news.raid.by_us.1: Paid %2$s a visit %3$s. They paid us back. Hah.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.news.robbery.by_us: Lightened a cart from %2$s %3$s. Easy work.
Took the toll off %2$s %3$s. They forgot to pay it.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.news.feud.by_us.0: Boss has it in for %2$s. Nobody's betting on how that ends.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.news.feud.by_us.1: We've sworn on the road against %2$s. No more easy passes.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.news.fell.by_us.0: We buried %2$s %3$s. Drank to him. Then we argued.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.news.killing.you.0: You did for %2$s %3$s. Boss hasn't stopped talking about it.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.news.killing.you.1: We know it was you that killed %2$s. %3$s. We don't forget a face.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.news.killing.us.0: One of ours got put in the ground %3$s. %1$s did it.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.news.killing.us.1: Somebody killed one of the lads %3$s. It was %1$s. That'll cost them.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.news.assault.you.0: You roughed up one of ours %3$s. He's still sore. So's his pride.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.news.rescue.you.0: You took back what we took off %2$s %3$s. We had a deal with that cart.
Since %3$s, %1$s has been poking round our camp. Boss noticed.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.news.pact_sworn.by: Boss made a deal with %2$s %3$s. Honour among thieves, he calls it.
mic_rtsim.talk.bandit.news.pact_broken.b: Our deal with %2$s fell through. They got the short end. On purpose.
